label: preparing
what: A coordinated grain-and-bread supply arrangement: builder and freight seek 19 hay bales, offering oak planks/services; the innkeeper needs grain and discussed credit or trade. Builder was observed handing planks to baker, and townsfolk reported baker and innkeeper (and at one point freight) together at the bakery. Their exact final agreement is not confirmed. Freight's later ferry/warehouse operations meeting is separately scheduled routine business, with no verified bridge or port change; the lighting inspection is an approved mayoral appointment, not secret preparation.
